content: Phenazone, also known as phenazon, is classified as an analgesic agent. It is synthesized through the reduction of diortho-dinitrodiphenyl using sodium amalgam and methyl alcohol. Alternatively, it can be produced by heating diphenylene-ortho-dihydrazine with hydrochloric acid at a temperature of 150°C. The compound crystallizes in the form of needle-like structures, which have a melting point of 156°C. When subjected to oxidation by potassium permanganate, phenazone is converted into pyridazine tetracarboxylic acid.
